can.text: Opens *.bib, *.ltx, *.tex files in its own view (Text is always one click away)

frame.manifest:
id = "demo"
name = "Demo"
version = "1.2.3"
summary = "A demo."
api = "0.2"
[[views]]
id = "doc"
title = "Doc"
slot = "file"
[[views]]
id = "panel"
title = "Panel"
slot = "tab"
[[files]]
match = ["*.tex", "*.ltx"]
view = "doc"
label = "LaTeX"
debounce_ms = 300
[[files]]
match = ["*.bib"]
view = "doc"
label = "BibTeX"
[[actions]]
match = ["*.tex"]
label = "Build"
action = "build"
[[settings]]
key = "on"
type = "bool"
default = true
label = "On"
[[settings]]
key = "n"
type = "number"
default = 1.5e1
min = -1
max = +600.0
label = "N"
scope = "host"
[[settings]]
key = "pick"
type = "enum"
default = 'A'
options = ['A', "B",]
label = "Pick"

cases.note: views, claimed file kinds, actions and settings: only the claims are capabilities
